To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

1) the Active8! intervention increased physical activity in health professionals, 2) the Active8 intervention increased active travel in health professionals, and 3) the Active8 e-mail intervention was superior to the SMS intervention for promoting active travel and moderate intensity physical activity in health workers.

1) the Active8! program was effective in increasing moderate intensity physical activity and active travel, 2) both the SMS and e-mail interventions were equally effective at increasing moderate intensity physical activities and active travel, and 3) the Active8 program had a positive impact on quality of life.
the Active8! intervention was successful at increasing the frequency of active travel and the duration of moderate intensity activity at work and during leisure.

the use of mobile phone short-message services (SMS) and e-mail is a promising method of delivering physical activity promotion in the workplace.
